description: Phase 1 automated abstraction pipeline — maps strategies to deep-tier sources and the servable chunk plan (PRD §5.1 D-4).

deepTierInclude: algorithm source code/Market Wave Pine Script.txt

chunkPlan.focus: Strategy behavioral contract: entry/exit philosophy, bar-close vs tick fills, envelope gating, sizing model, and iterative tuning posture — no proprietary defaults.
Bar-percent entry and exit thresholds: roles, directional effects, safe retail experimentation bands — split from other params (D-4).
Scope/lookback envelope and buy-below / sell-above gating with optional percentage buffers.
Fixed notional vs percent-of-equity sizing, minimum order notional, clip behavior.
Trend-change buy/sell deferral gates, static price ceiling/floor filters, date/time window behavior.
Capital allocation window, effective cash/position accounting for sizing — generic ranges only.
Conservative vs aggressive posture recipes, chop/trend guidance, forward try-values grounded in visible chart context.
Drawdown sensitivity, invalidating conditions, liquidity/volatility caveats for spot crypto long-only use.
